title: Ductless Mini-Splits in Olmos Park, TX
desc: Do you need a new ductless mini-split? Call Rosenberg Plumbing & Airhelp to install a ductless air conditioner in your Olmos Park home.

blocks.text: At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we’re ready to help with any type of ductless mini-split unit you have in your Olmos Park, TX, home. Whether you want a new ductless unit installed or your current one repaired, it’s best to have a professional take care of the details of the job. A ductless air conditioner can be a great investment in your home. These units have an outside condenser that is hooked up to individual units that can be placed throughout your home. You’ll be able to set each unit to a different temperature based on how you use a space. This can lower your energy bills and reduce wear and tear on your mini-split system. An expert can help you choose a unit that’s the right size for your home and within your budget.

Having a ductless system to cool your home during the hot summer months can save you a lot of money in the long run. When our technicians install a new unit, they’ll set up your system for optimal operation. You’ll receive training on the care and operation of your new ductless air conditioner.

If you suspect that your mini-split unit is having an issue, a professional can find the cause of the problem. Whether your system is icing over, making strange noises, or not keeping your home at the right temperature, you’ll want to get it looked at as soon as possible. Fixing small problems early can keep them from developing into anything more serious in the future.
